title: plugin-sharing: the #8418 phantom-anchor write-deny diagnostic goes silent on a federated object that maps owner_id through external.columnMap over a plugin driver that ignores the map (epic #27261)
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Filing gate: ① operator-diagnostic regression owed by landed work (#27425, PR #27476 `f57eddcf`), from the post-landing contract review 6493803142 (④ should-fix 3) and the seat carry 6493297056.
Reader: the epic PM (#27261) dispatches it in the epic subtree; the fix is in `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/` (`notePhantomAnchorWriteDeny` and its caller).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "phantom anchor write-deny diagnostic notePhantomAnchorWriteDeny columnMap map-ignoring plugin driver" → 0 hits.
reach: read on `main`, not measured live. `notePhantomAnchorWriteDeny` (#8418) keys on `hasPhantomOwnerAnchor`, which answers `false` since #27425 when `external.columnMap` maps a remote column onto `owner_id`. A plugin driver does not apply `columnMap`, so its rows carry no `owner_id`; every member write is refused (fail closed, correct), but the one-line server log that tells the operator why no longer fires. `security-external-owner-unmapped` still warns at author time.
type: Bug

## 维护者速读

- **现象：** 外部对象用 `columnMap` 把远端列映到 `owner_id`，但用的是不应用映射的插件驱动时，成员写入全部被拒（正确），但服务器不再打出那行「为什么被拒」的诊断日志。
- **原因：** 诊断按 `hasPhantomOwnerAnchor` 触发，#27425 把这种映射算作已证 owner，于是诊断不再触发。
- **影响：** 只影响运维排查；不泄露、不改判。作者侧的 lint 警告仍在。
- **最小修法：** 对 mapped 对象，在按 owner 判写时读到的 owner 为空时也打这行诊断，文字点名「驱动没有返回映射的 owner 列」。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] On a federated object whose `columnMap` maps onto `owner_id`, a refused member write whose pre-image carries no `owner_id` logs the #8418 diagnostic once per object (same rate limit), naming that the driver returned no value for the mapped owner column.
- [ ] Pins: a map-ignoring plugin driver logs it; a map-applying driver (owner present) and a declared-owner control do not. Verdicts unchanged.

`Clause-②: no` (log text only) · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
